title: Melting Time Dreamscape
description: A surreal scene featuring a large profile silhouette of a person's face on a maroon background. From the head emerges a winding river-like path filled with melting clocks, flowing from a vintage yellow camera placed on a red plaid picnic blanket. A pink bowl with colorful flowers sits in the foreground while twisted trees with more melting clocks hang from above against a starry sky.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork showing a large side profile of a human head in white line against a deep maroon background. A winding river composed of melting Dali-style clocks flows from a bright yellow vintage camera resting on a red tartan picnic blanket. In the foreground is a pink bowl filled with purple, orange and green flowers. Twisted trees with green leaves and hanging melting clocks frame the top of the image, one side with a green hill, all under a starry night sky.
